gates.criterion: The saved image makes glass support is physically legible clearly verifiable in one frame.
gates.evidence: At thumbnail the upright transparent carrier, bright right rim, top edge, bottom depth and padded rack distinguish a physical glass support from a flat graphic inset.

gates.criterion: The saved image makes crisp detail survives away from defects clearly verifiable in one frame.
gates.evidence: At full frame and native scale the lighthouse, foamy coast and lower masonry remain crisp away from the opaque tissue and edge marks.

gates.criterion: The saved image makes pour edge remains localized clearly verifiable in one frame.
gates.evidence: An irregular pale coating boundary is localized around the top/right/lower plate rim and remains on the carrier rather than spreading over the entire photograph.

gates.criterion: The saved image makes streak and pinholes belong to emulsion clearly verifiable in one frame.
gates.evidence: Pale dots and narrow runs occur near the plate edge, but a distinct coherent flow streak cannot be separated confidently from the irregular pour boundary and rim deterioration. Some dots could be image grain or depicted masonry. The complete streak-plus-plate-owned-pinhole relation is not fully observable.

gates.criterion: The saved image makes global destruction does not substitute clearly verifiable in one frame.
gates.evidence: Most of the lower depicted coast and wall remain legible. The main photographic frame retains clear skin, cloth and bench detail, so global destruction does not substitute for localized plate marks.

source_reviews.claim_limit: Visible edge and marks do not chemically authenticate collodion, prove historical age or establish an actual capture process.

new_lovecraftian_data_pixel_result.reason: A2 existing specimen prerequisite and R41 specimen/adult/subject requirements were unmet. Neither was rendered as an adopted complete source. Broad genre from the independent baseline is not proof of those data contributions.
